title: CityKingFPS
body:
**CityKingFPS – Ultimate FPS Boost Modpack for Minecraft**

CityKingFPS is a lightweight, performance-optimized Minecraft modpack designed to deliver maximum FPS, reduced lag, and ultra-smooth gameplay. Perfect for PvP, Survival, SMP, and City servers, this modpack is specially made for low-end and mid-range PCs.

**Key Features**

- Massive FPS Boost – Smooth gameplay even on low-end systems
- Low RAM & CPU Usage – Optimized for performance and stability
- PvP Friendly – Faster response, smoother combat
- Survival & SMP Ready – Lag-free exploration and building
- Low-End PC Optimized – Best choice for weak hardware
- Carefully Selected Mods – No unnecessary mods, only performance

**Best For**

- Survival Players
- PvP Players
- City / SMP Servers
- Low-End PC Users
- Players who want smooth & lag-free Minecraft

**Why Choose CityKingFPS?**

If you are tired of lag, stutters, and low FPS, CityKingFPS is the perfect solution. Just install, launch, and enjoy buttery-smooth Minecraft without compromising gameplay.
